body: An app that brings language models directly to your phone.
plain_description: Run a private AI assistant entirely on your phone — no account, no cloud, no internet required. Your conversations, documents, and voice data never leave your device. Free and open source with no subscription or 'pro' tier.
technical_description: PocketPal AI is a React Native mobile application that runs large language models and text-to-speech models entirely on-device via local inference, with no network connection required after setup. It employs a four-layer architecture: React Native UI with MobX state management and WatermelonDB persistence; native bridging through llama.rn and react-native-speech; inference engines llama.cpp for GGUF-quantized LLMs and ONNX Runtime for TTS models; and hardware acceleration targeting CPU, GPU (Metal on iOS), and NPU (Qualcomm Hexagon). The AgentRunner drives a tool-use loop that enables Talents (calculator, datetime, HTML rendering) for agentic capabilities. Models are downloaded from Hugging Face or local storage and selected by quantization level to fit device memory.
title: PocketPal AI
